hook: Your Maps view of Lonar shows a round lake that turned pink.
title: This Indian Lake Turned Pink Overnight
description:
Lonar Lake in Maharashtra sits inside a crater formed by a meteor impact. In 2020 its water turned pink, and scientists linked the change to microorganisms in the salty water. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #LonarLake #IndiaFacts
